items.zh: 客家話有**介音** `i`，是廣州話沒有的，要注意發音。例如{{餅}} `biăng`、{{茄}} `kiō`、{{向}} `hiòng`、{{腳}} `giŏk`、{{銀}} `ngiūn`、{{艾}} `ngiòi`。
items.en: Hakka has the **i-medial**, which Cantonese lacks. Pay attention to the pronunciation. E.g., 'cake' ({{餅}} `biăng`), 'eggplant' ({{茄}} `kiō`), 'direction' ({{向}} `hiòng`), 'leg' ({{腳}} `giŏk`), 'silver' ({{銀}} `ngiūn`), 'mugwort' ({{艾}} `ngiòi`).

items.zh: 客家話有 `ung` / `iung` 的對立，例如{公: gung1}{工: gung1}{攻: gung1} / {弓: giung1}{宮: giung1}{恭: giung1}。要注意發音。
items.en: Hakka distinguishes between `ung` and `iung`. For example: 'public/work/attack' ({公: gung1}{工: gung1}{攻: gung1}) vs. 'bow/palace/respect' ({弓: giung1}{宮: giung1}{恭: giung1}). Pay attention to the pronunciation.

items.zh: {{先生}}有兩個發音：(a) `sín sáng` 意思為老師。(b) `sien sáng` 是對成年男性的禮貌稱呼。
items.en: {{先生}} has two pronunciations: (a) `sín sáng` means teacher. (b) `sien sáng` is a polite title for an adult male (Mr.).

items.zh: 普通話的疑問詞「哪」，客家話發音是 `lài`（中文字寫作{{奈}}）。
items.en: The Mandarin question word 「哪」 is pronounced `lài` in Hakka (written as {{奈}}).

items.zh: 「哪裏」有三個說法：{奈埞: lai4 tang4}、{奈裏: lai4 li1}、{奈: lai4}。其中{奈埞: lai4 tang4}是惠陽腔特有**口語詞**。
items.en: There are three ways to say 'where': {奈埞: lai4 tang4}, {奈裏: lai4 li1}, {奈: lai4}. Among them, {奈埞: lai4 tang4} is a colloquial term specific to the **Fuiyong accent**.

items.zh: {{吂}}是客家話常用詞，惠陽腔包括香港的發音是 `mān`。代表「尚未」發生的動作（沒、沒有）。
items.en: {{吂}} is a common Hakka word, pronounced `mān` in the **Fuiyong accent** (including Hong Kong). It indicates an action that has 'not yet' happened.
